description.zh: 实例组数量，默认值为1，最大值为100。
description.en: The number of instance groups. Default value: 1. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh: 是否自动付费。默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: false.

description.zh: 是否开启自动续费。默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Default value: false.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)查询云手机支持购买的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions where cloud phone instances can be purchased.

description.zh: 计费类型。
description.en: The billing type.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。不超过100个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated submissions. The value cannot exceed 100 characters in length.

description.zh: > 该参数暂未对外开放使用。
description.en: > This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh: 是否开启GPU加速。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable GPU acceleration.

description.zh: 镜像ID。可以通过调用[DescribeImageList](~~DescribeImageList~~)查询云手机的镜像列表。
description.en: The image ID. You can call [DescribeImageList](~~DescribeImageList~~) to query the list of cloud phone images.

description.zh:
实例组名称。

> 实例组名称长度不超过30个字符；请以大/小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，仅支持中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）。
description.en:
The instance group name.

> The instance group name cannot exceed 30 characters in length. It must start with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 实例组规格。可以通过调用[DescribeSpec](~~DescribeSpec~~)查询云手机支持购买的规格。
description.en: The instance group specification. You can call [DescribeSpec](~~DescribeSpec~~) to query the specifications available for cloud phone instances.

description.zh: > 该参数暂未对外开放使用。
description.en: > This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh:
密钥对ID。创建实例组的时候，如果指定了合法的密钥对ID，会在这次创建成功的实例上，都绑定该密钥对，不用再重新调用绑定接口。

> 目前还不支持扩容的时候绑定密钥对。
description.en:
The key pair ID. If you specify a valid key pair ID when creating an instance group, the key pair is bound to all instances that are successfully created, without the need to call the bindng operation again.

> Binding a key pair during scale-out is not supported.

description.zh: 实例组中的实例数量。最大值为100。
description.en: The number of instances in the instance group. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
网络ID。

- 创建共享网络实例：网络ID选填。填写[云手机控制台>网络](https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network)页面中类型为**共享网络**的网络ID。如果控制台没有共享网络，可以不用填写，将会在创建实例组时自动创建一个共享网络。

- 创建VPC网络实例：网络ID必填。填写[云手机控制台>网络](https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network)页面中类型为**VPC网络**的网络ID，如果控制台没有VPC网络，则需要先创建网络。
description.en:
The network ID.

- To create a shared network instance: the network ID is optional. Specify the network ID of the **Shared Network** type on the [Cloud Phone console > Network](https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network) page. If no shared network exists in the console, you can leave this parameter empty. A shared network is automatically created when the instance group is created.

- To create a VPC network instance: the network ID is required. Specify the network ID of the **VPC Network** type on the [Cloud Phone console > Network](https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network) page. If no VPC network exists in the console, create a network first.

description.zh: 购买资源的时长，单位由PeriodUnit指定。
description.en: The subscription duration of the resource. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit.

description.zh: 购买资源的时长单位。
description.en: The unit of the subscription duration.

description.zh: 策略ID。可以通过调用[ListPolicyGroups](~~ListPolicyGroups~~)查询策略列表。
description.en: The policy ID. You can call [ListPolicyGroups](~~ListPolicyGroups~~) to query the list of policies.

description.zh: 资源的标签。
description.en: The tags of the resource.

description.zh: 标签键。
description.en: The tag key.

description.zh: 标签值。
description.en: The tag value.

description.zh:
交换机 ID。可以通过调用[DescribeVSwitches](~~448774~~)查询交换机列表。

- 创建共享网络实例：不填写。

- 创建VPC网络实例：交换机 ID 必填。选用此交换机来创建实例。
description.en:
The vSwitch ID. You can call [DescribeVSwitches](~~448774~~) to query the list of vSwitches.

- To create a shared network instance: leave this parameter empty.

- To create a VPC network instance: the vSwitch ID is required. The specified vSwitch is used to create the instance.

descriptions.zh:
<props="china">创建云手机实例组前，需要完成实名认证。详细信息，参见[个人实名认证](~~48263~~)。</props>

创建云手机实例组时，请注意，创建实例组会涉及资源计费，建议您提前了解云手机实例组的[计费方式](~~2807121~~)。

  - 若实例组的计费方式为包年包月（PrePaid），默认AutoPay（自动支付）的值为false，调用接口后需要前往<props="china">[阿里云费用与成本](https://usercenter2.aliyun.com/order/list)</props><props="intl">[阿里云费用与成本](https://usercenter2-intl.aliyun.com/order/list)</props>手动支付订单。

 - 如果需要自动支付则设置AutoPay的值为true。
descriptions.en:
<props="china">Before creating a cloud phone instance group, complete real-name verification. For more information, see [verify your identity - Individual account](~~48263~~).</props>

When you create a cloud phone instance group, note that creating an instance group incurs resource charges. Familiarize yourself with the [billable methods](~~2807121~~) of cloud phone instance groups in advance.

  - If the billing method of the instance group is subscription (PrePaid), the default value of AutoPay is false. After you invoke this operation, go to <props="china">[Expenses and Costs](https://usercenter2.aliyun.com/order/list)</props><props="intl">[Expenses and Costs](https://usercenter2-intl.aliyun.com/order/list)</props> to manually pay for the order.

 - If you want to enable automatic payment, set AutoPay to true.
